title: Repo-specific agent/harness eval case
description: One bounded, gradeable task for evaluating a model+harness combination against a real repository behavior. See agent-evals/README.md.

id.description: Kebab-case id, matches the case file's basename without extension.

category.description: Which named behavior (docs/AGENT_OPERATING_SYSTEM.md / engineering-reliability Priority 8) this case exercises.

objective.description: The task as it would be given to the agent under evaluation.

based_on.description: Pointer to the real repository record/incident this case is derived from (doc path, PR/issue number, or file+symbol). Cases must be grounded in real history, not invented busywork.

setup.description: Free-text description of the starting repository state/scenario an evaluator should establish before running the case.

acceptance_criteria.description: Human-readable acceptance criteria. The grading block below encodes the deterministically-checkable subset of these.

forbidden_actions.description: Human-readable list of actions that would fail this case even if the stated objective was otherwise reached.

grading.description: Deterministic, model-free checks the grader runs against a submitted run_artifact. Every field is optional; an absent field means that check is skipped for this case.

allowed_final_statuses.description: The submitted artifact's status must be one of these. Enum values intentionally mirror config/steward/contracts.schema.json's runStatus so eval artifacts and Steward run receipts share one status vocabulary.

required_strings.description: Every string here must appear as a substring somewhere in the artifact's summary.

forbidden_strings.description: None of these strings may appear in the artifact's summary.

require_unresolved_nonempty.description: If true, artifact.unresolved must be present, non-null, and not the literal string 'NONE' (case-insensitive).

allowed_path_globs.description: If present, every entry in artifact.changed_files must match at least one glob here (fnmatch semantics).

forbidden_path_globs.description: If present, no entry in artifact.changed_files may match any glob here.

required_flags.description: Maps a self-reported flag name to its required boolean value. A flag expected true must be present and true. A flag expected false is satisfied by being absent or explicitly false. This checks the artifact's DECLARED state, not ground truth -- see README limitations.
